column1: # The smithing manuals (Nate, 2026-09-30: "do both, gives scholars more meaning"). A Blacksmith's tier lets them work a
# metal; reading its manual shows them its recipes. DBO_BlacksmithTiers.pas creates each marker SPEL (a copy of
# DBO_Skill_cook_T1, inert) and each BOOK (a copy of DBO_RecipeRevivePotion, the Draught of Revival's recipe book: no
# skill, no script) in DragonBreak Online Edits.esp, and puts the text of manuals/<manual>.txt in the book. Reading a
# book adds its marker for good: that is the gameplay side (Worker G), keyed on the book's editor id.
# Titles and texts are drafts for Nate. "source" is the canon each one rests on; "new" means written for DragonBreak.
